title: Star Instructor, Master Baek
altTitles: Number One Star Instructor Master Baek
Master Baek, the One Hit Teacher
description: Suryong Baek, once the finest instructor of the Blood Cult, is killed after learning the martial arts of four captured masters. He mysteriously awakens in the body of Baek Suryong, a young martial arts instructor suffering from a terminal illness. Knowing that his new body's condition can be cured through the martial arts he learned in his previous life, he needs a huge amount of money. Baek Suryong therefore sets out to become a star instructor at the Azure Dragon Martial Arts Academy while teaching his students and building his new life.
author: Ganjjajang / S.J. Lee
